findings.message: S500 is the speed in force when the tapping block on line 36 (CYCLE84) runs. A tap's feed follows from its speed and its pitch, so the speed is left as written: scaled on its own it would break the tap. Change the speed and the feed together by hand if the tap should run at another speed.
